subject: Intro to FinPay — AWS co-sell & joint account orchestration
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro request — FinPay co-sell and joint account plan

Samir,

Quick ask: can you open a co-sell intro to the FinPay team (decision makers copied below) and help us align on a 30–45 minute joint kickoff next week? FinPay is evaluating inference for document processing and fraud detection; they mentioned procurement timeline Q1 2028 and sensitivity around PII/data residency.

High level on our side:
- Redwood inference runtime already benchmarks well on their throughput targets (we'll share numbers)
- Proposed joint ask: 30-min intro -> 45-min technical deep dive -> LA-based pilot (2–4 weeks)

I've cc'd Laura (AM) and Karthik (partner eng). Would appreciate an intro thread that copies in FinPay's buyer and technical lead so we can lock a time and agree a mutual action plan.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao

Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro request — FinPay co-sell and joint account plan

Aditya — thanks for the note. Forwarding to FinPay leadership and copying my AWS co-sell team. Grand/Nina — hello, Samir from AWS Partner Dev here. Redwood Inference is a verified partner in our marketplace and has a good fit for your batch inference and fraud pipelines.

Would you be open to an initial 30-minute alignment call? Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 10/19 10:00–10:30
- Tue 10/19 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10/20 09:00–09:30

If those don't work, tell us a window and we'll accommodate. I can pull in our solutions architect for the technical deep dive.

Best,
Samir
